title: Just released a demo today. Build your train, protect the city!
author: crumbaker
selftext:
The premise is this is you, and your allies last stand. To keep the remaining cities free of corporate rule, you build an Iron Maw to protect them. A war train you can customize. Demo is here if anyone wants to give it a try: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5311750/Iron\_Maw/?beta=0](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5311750/Iron_Maw/?beta=0)

I made this one in Astra. However I would suggest people use Opus 5.5 instead, as it seems to do a lot better understanding the look I'm going for generally, and mcp's aren't really needed. Anyway I used the Blender mcp for the models. And just made a basic layout of what I wanted the gameplay to be, then got more specific as I went along.

comments.author: dmarshallgaming
comments.body: Looks great, love the angle on the island shoreline and the war train concept. Congrats on the demo launch! Nice to hear the Blender MCP worked well for the models.

replies.author: crumbaker
replies.body: Thanks, for future projects the mcp will not be used though. Opus just doesn't seem to need it all. I have since switched from Astra to Opus for all projects. Who knows if that will change when 6.2 comes out.

replies.author: dmarshallgaming
replies.body: You were using Opus with Blender without MCP?

comments.author: Left-Prompt7557
comments.body:
Looks fun, I like the concept and the way it looks, it's a fun twist on tower defence! I've always thought a 'maw' was a mouth/gap though, so not quite sure I understand the game title. 

Also, you night want to have another go at the sound effects, that very tactile clicky sound for the guns is distinctive of AI sfx. I had the exact same problem in my game and with some prompting and iteration it can sound a lot more natural!

replies.author: crumbaker
replies.body: The sound effects actually aren't ai lol(well the track noise is but I thought it came out perfect). With a machine gun that you're shooting a lot so you have to find a sound that's not going to be too jarring, you don't switch weapons on this except when you buy new rail cars. This is close to exactly what an mp5 sounds like from a distance.
